integrity: Explicit all-initial-condition analytic proof with exact rational covariance identities, deterministic equality and instability witnesses, and a standalone verifier; full originality remains subject to independent literature assessment.
limitations: Identity/orthogonal rows, constant positive iid row probabilities, one committed-step-old scalar residual, additive corrections, and exact arithmetic; no guarantee for general asynchronous scheduling, nonorthogonal matrices, adaptive sampling, or random delay lengths.
title: Sharp row-diversity threshold for one-step-stale randomized Kaczmarz
